name: Kiel (United States)

colors.symbolism: quarters of the German and Kiel flags
quarters of the Kiel and Schleswig-Holstein flags

description: Quartered from the flags of Germany, the city of Kiel in Germany, Wisconsin, and Schleswig-Holstein, with a purple central disc reading KIEL / WI / 1854.
history: Kiel, Wisconsin, was founded by mid-nineteenth-century German immigrants who named the new community after Kiel in Schleswig-Holstein. The municipal flag adapts the heraldry of the German parent city.

features.role: heritage flags of Germany, Kiel, Wisconsin and Schleswig-Holstein
